name: DBHub (Bytebase) database MCP server
description: Multi-database MCP server (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite) with read-only mode, row limits and query timeouts. Runs over stdio or an HTTP transport selected by --transport; v1 records stdio only.

provenance.notes: npm latest 1.5.0 published 2026-10-09, license MIT, mcpName io.github.bytebase/dbhub. Supports version.

README: '--transport stdio' and '--transport http --port 8080'; guardrails read-only mode, row limiting, query timeout; SSH tunnelling and TLS to the database. No client-to-server authentication documented, recorded as auth none (database credentials go in the DSN, not MCP auth). trust_level is a t4c research suggestion, not a security approval: trusted_external = maintained by the vendor whose API it fronts or by a named organisation, with publisher identity checked against the official MCP Registry namespace or the vendor's own docs; it does not make returned content trusted (see note, #35).
LICENSE is the MIT License. Supports license.
